chapters.title: Analysis mode icon and search captions

features.name: Analysis mode icon redesign
features.description: New icon for analysis mode that takes up less space while maintaining the same functionality to turn analysis mode on and off.

features.name: Removal of search and analysis mode captions
features.description: Captions for search and analysis mode have been removed from the action bar to create more space.

features.name: Copilot on action bar
features.description: Copilot is now integrated into the action bar, making it easier to reach Copilot actions on any list page.

features.name: Action bar made standard
features.description: The updated action bar is now standard for all users, with the process tab renamed to home for better clarity.

features.name: Split buttons for fast access
features.description: Split buttons now group popular actions on the home tab for faster access to frequently used functions.

quotes.text: Updates to the action bar in 2024 release wave one make it simpler to use and make you more productive.
quotes.why_it_matters: Establishes the timing and goals of the feature release for the 2024 wave one.
